The three ShopSeed passes are separate filters, but the final item ID selected within each pass depends on the native RNG and current source indices.

For state 2 and state 3, builders merge ItemKind, ItemFrom, season, and derived-class bitsets before selection. This artifact maps call order and slot placement, not the complete item membership of each merged set.
